preImageRead: Production 1m longs on BTC/SOL/ETH around 14:45-15:03 UTC: forming 14:45-14:47, then 10+ minutes of total silence (nothing in candidateSetups) 14:48-14:57 while a flag had actually failed at 14:48, then either nothing (ETH/SOL) or a new flag forming (BTC) 14:58-15:00, forming->triggering 15:01-15:02, confirmed at 15:03. SOL never showed the triggering flag its own chart had at 14:52, and SOL's confirmed flag (14:53) vanished from the payload at 14:57 with no explanation instead of aging out visibly.
missingFeature: Four compounding gaps: (1) flag.includeFailed:false plus no failed-visibility window meant a failed candidate disappeared outright instead of reading 'failed at 14:48, reason'; (2) flag.maxImpulseCandles:8 was too short to see SOL's longer pump, so the search never found the pole behind the 14:52 flag; (3) flag.maxBreakoutAge:5 silently dropped a confirmed flag from the search entirely once its break was more than 5 candles old, with no expired/aging state to replace it; (4) flag.minCandles:3 plus the live chart's unclosed candle put every read 1-3 minutes behind the eye, and there was no proto state for the 1-2 pullback candles right after an impulse.
postImageRead: Replayed via scripts/replay.js against test/fixtures/history/2026-09-23 (test-replay.js MISS_003 via replay): 1m long candidates for BTC, ETH and SOL never read 'none' at any close from 14:45 to 15:03 - every close shows proto/forming/triggering/confirmed/expired/failed with a reason. SOL specifically: forming 14:45-14:47, failed (with failReason) 14:48-14:51, triggering at 14:52 (the flag production never showed), confirmed 14:53-14:56, expired (not gone) 14:57-15:00 once past maxBreakoutAge, forming again 15:01, triggering 15:02, confirmed 15:03. BTC and ETH show the equivalent failed-with-reason and forming/triggering/confirmed sequences at the same closes, matching the plan's Root-causes replay exactly.
fixLocation: lib/patternDetector.js (proto state, maxImpulseCandles 8->20, EMA21 reclaim, expired state, cheap geometry fields, stable-identity offsets), lib/patternLifecycle.js (identifyCandidate: candidateId/firstDetectedAt/failedAt), lib/candidateQualifier.js (qual, new module), services/scalpContext.js (failedTtl-aware filterFailedCandidateSetups, qual/identity wiring, CANDLE_LIMITS 24->20 on 1m/3m/5m for payload budget), config/engine.json (flag.reclaimCandles, flag.failedTtlCandles, flag.expiredTtlCandles, flag.quality, flag.maxImpulseCandles).
proposedFeature: docs/PLAN_FLAG_DETECTION_COVERAGE.md (F1) Build items 1-8: proto state; wider impulse lookback; EMA21 reclaim; failed stays visible for failedTtlCandles with failedAt; expired state for a confirmed flag aging past maxBreakoutAge; stable candidateId/firstDetectedAt; cheap geometry fields (flagSlope/breakoutDistancePct/invalidationDistancePct); a compact qual (quality/decision/reasons) layer separate from detection.
